release_title: MiniMax M2.7: Early Echoes of Self-Evolution

models.name: MiniMax-M2.7
models.variant: first M-series model deeply participating in its own evolution; Agent Teams, complex Skills, dynamic tool search
models.capability_summary: MiniMax 发布 M2.7「Early Echoes of Self-Evolution」，定位为首个深度参与自身进化的 M 系列模型，支持 Agent Teams、复杂 Skills 与动态工具搜索。评测集中在智能体与编码，亮点如 SWE-Bench Pro 56.2%、MLE-Bench Lite 66.6%。

locator.heading: Professional Software Engineering / Professional Work
locator.quote_snippet: On the SWE-Pro benchmark, M2.7 scored 56.22%, nearly approaching Opus's best level

benchmark_evidence.notes: swebench-pro id already introduced by prior batches. Later prose: 'matching GPT-5.3-Codex'.
new-benchmark: swebench-multilingual already introduced by prior batches.
new-benchmark: multi-swe-bench already introduced by prior batches.

locator.heading: Professional Software Engineering / Professional Work
locator.quote_snippet: On the repo-level code generation benchmark VIBE-Pro, M2.7 scored 55.6%, nearly on par with Opus 4.6

benchmark_evidence.notes: new-benchmark: vibe-pro not yet in data/benchmarks/ (MiniMax-upgraded Pro version of the VIBE repo-level generation benchmark; also referenced in minimax-m2-5.json).

locator.heading: Professional Software Engineering / Professional Work
locator.quote_snippet: deep understanding of complex engineering systems on Terminal Bench 2 (57.0%)

benchmark_evidence.notes: Version printed as 'Terminal Bench 2'; harness undisclosed.
nl2repo id already introduced by prior batches.

locator.heading: Professional Software Engineering / Professional Work
locator.quote_snippet: Its ELO score on GDPval-AA is 1495, the highest among open-source models

benchmark_evidence.notes: gdpval-aa id already introduced by prior batches. Elo unit - never aggregate with percent rows. Prose: 'among 45 models, second only to Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, and GPT5.4, surpassing GPT5.3'. Chart panel (vision, 2026-09-01) prints the same comparison in percent-style bars: M2.7 50 / M2.5 35 / Gemini 3.1 Pro 41 / Sonnet 4.6 57 / Opus 4.6 55 / GPT 5.4 58 - ranking matches the prose (above M2.7: Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4). ELO 1495 from prose stays the primary record.

locator.heading: Professional Software Engineering / Professional Work
locator.quote_snippet: On Toolathon, M2.7 achieved an accuracy of 46.3%, reaching the global top tier

benchmark_evidence.notes: new-benchmark: tool-decathlon. Page spells it 'Toolathon'; the 46.3 value matches GLM-5.1's Tool-Decathlon column for M2.7 exactly, so the tool-decathlon mapping is near-certain (cross-vendor confirmation) - spelling discrepancy recorded.

locator.heading: Professional Software Engineering / Professional Work
locator.quote_snippet: The average medal rate across the three runs was 66.6%, a result second only to Opus-4.6 (75.7%) and GPT-5.4 (71.2%)

protocol.time_limit: 3 trials x 24 hours iterative evolution each

benchmark_evidence.notes: mlebench id exists in data/benchmarks/. Metric is medal rate (medals/competitions), not accuracy. Best single run: 9 gold / 5 silver / 1 bronze of 22. Harness: short-term memory + self-feedback + self-optimization loop (vendor-designed).

locator.heading: Professional Software Engineering / Professional Work
locator.quote_snippet: M2.7 maintained a 97% skill compliance rate across 40 complex skills (each exceeding 2,000 tokens)

benchmark_evidence.notes: new-benchmark: mm-claw not yet in data/benchmarks/ (MiniMax internal skill-adherence suite). Metric is a compliance rate over long skills - distinct construct from task accuracy.

locator.heading: OpenClaw / MM Claw
locator.quote_snippet: M2.7 achieved a level close to Sonnet 4.6 on this test, with an accuracy of 62.7%

benchmark_evidence.notes: MM Claw accuracy claim ("level close to Sonnet 4.6"). Chart read (vision, 2026-09-01): M2.7 62.7 vs M2.5 57.6 / Gemini 3.1 Pro 61.8 / Sonnet 4.6 64.2 / Opus 4.6 75.4 / GPT 5.4 73.6. Distinct from the 97% skill-adherence entry (40 complex skills).

protocol.aggregation: Artificial Analysis aggregate (integer scale in chart)

benchmark_evidence.notes: Chart-only value (vision read, 2026-09-01): M2.7 50 vs M2.5 42 / Gemini 3.1 Pro 57 / Sonnet 4.6 52 / Opus 4.6 53 / GPT 5.4 57. No prose claim about AA on the M2.7 page.

protocol.harness: AppCIF 官方评测管线（run_eval.py：pull_answer → evaluate → calculate_accuracy；逐条细则由 LLM 裁判单独判定）
protocol.judge: Doubao-Seed-1.6-1015（论文初始版数据 2,998 条细则的判分模型；仓库 v1.1 改用 Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite 判分，同一判分提示词）

benchmark_evidence.notes: AppCIF-Bench 官方仓库 Leaderboard 表中「Minimax-M2.7」行的 SSR L1 列（SSR 软满足率 = 被满足的细则占全部细则的比例；本列分母为 727 条细则）。本列为该难度档的分档数值。口径警示：榜单是中文版数据、论文初始版 2,998 条细则、由 Doubao-Seed-1.6-1015 判分；仓库现发布 v1.1（466 样本 / 3,017 条细则）并改用 Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite 判分，官方明示两套分数不可直接比较，故本行数值不代表该模型在 v1.1 上的表现。同列竞品（取本表其他行数值）：GPT-5.4-xhigh 79.1 / Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 82.4 / Doubao-Seed-2.0-Pro-high 66.6 / GLM-5.1 65.2 / Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 66.4 / Kimi-K2.5-Thinking 60.4 / Qwen-3.6-Plus-Thinking 57.4 / Grok-4.2 55.3 / DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 48.0 / Xiaomi-MiMo-V2-Pro 42.0 / Xiaomi-MiMo-V2-Omni 39.1。该列最佳：Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 82.4。榜单由基准所有者（腾讯）自建自跑并自报，非第三方独立评测，横向比较仅限同一判分模型与同一数据版本内。AppCIF 榜单标签「Minimax-M2.7」对应账本 release minimax-m2-7 / model minimax-m2-7。官方原始页面归档 models/2026-11-05-appcif-bench/；数据集与评测代码 https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/AppCIF-Bench ；项目页 https://ac2333.github.io/AppCIF/ 。
